Spacecraft name DARLA-02 (Demonstration of Artificial Reasoning, Learning, and Analysis)
Form factor CubeSat
Units or mass 3U

Launcher not launched
Organisation Saint Louis University
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education

Oneliner

Demonstrate autonomous event response and create a dynamic map of the radio frequency background noise in the amateur UHF band.
Description

Demonstrate autonomous event response on a 3U spacecraft and create a dynamic map of the radio frequency background noise in the amateur ultra-high frequency band. DARLA-02 follows DARLA, which is targeted to launch with CSLI in 2024. This follow-up seeks to double the amount of time the spacecraft can be in science mode in orbit.
